clue.text: Concerned with infiltrating aircraft, perhaps, or ship

indicators.note: to infiltrate is to get inside, so the regarding-word sits within the plane

parts.note: a fighter is one example of an aircraft, hence 'perhaps'
RE is the Latin-derived 'in the matter of', meaning concerned with

explanation.surface: Someone involved in sneaking into aircraft, or perhaps into a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aircraft, perhaps' marks the fighter as one example of a plane; 'or' simply links the wordplay to 'ship'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cargo vessel is called a freighter, a kind of ship.

clue.text: Egghead in rapid meal

indicators.note: the head letter of the word egg is set within the word for rapid

parts.note: rapid means fast
the head, or first letter, of 'egg' is E

explanation.surface: A clever intellectual gulping down a quick lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual, but it is read as 'egg's head', its first letter E; 'in' puts it inside FAST.
explanation.definitionFit: A large celebratory meal is a banquet or feast.

clue.text: Contrives to construct serene setting for the trap

indicators.note: a setting holds a jewel, so the rearranged letters surround the trap like a mount
to construct is to build something new out of the letters given

parts.note: a gin is a snare or trap for game

explanation.surface: Someone schemes to build a peaceful backdrop for an ambush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the trap' suggests a snare in the scene; gin here is an old word for an animal trap.
explanation.definitionFit: To engineer a result is to contrive or arrange it artfully.

clue.text: Fruit for a third person

definitions.meaning: a hairy green berry grown on a thorny bush
an unwanted third party accompanying a courting couple

explanation.definitionFit: The berry name doubles as British slang for someone who intrudes on a couple's date; 'playing gooseberry' means being the spare chaperone.

clue.text: Old gossips put restraints on a couple of bachelors

indicators.note: the restraints are put round the letters that follow, enclosing them

parts.note: ties are bonds or restraints

indicators.note: a couple means two, so the bachelor letter appears twice

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bachelor

explanation.surface: Elderly busybodies tie down two single men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put ... on' is read as restraints placed round the letters. TABBY is a dated word for a gossiping elderly spinster.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabby was a dated term for an elderly woman given to tittle-tattle, a spinster gossip.

clue.text: Go over the experience of swallowing ecstasy to ease the pain

indicators.note: swallowing takes something inside, so the drug letter goes in

parts.note: to relive something is to experience it again
E is the common abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Revisiting a trip on ecstasy as a painkiller.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve suffering is to ease or alleviate it.

clue.text: Tale of fellow expert

parts.note: able means skilled, expert

explanation.surface: A story about a skilled colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: A short moral story with animal characters is a tale of that kind.

clue.text: Young swimmers accept university is the rage

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so the university letter goes inside

parts.note: fry are young fish

explanation.surface: Juvenile swimmers getting into college is all the rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Young swimmers' suggests children at a pool; it means fish fry. 'is the' links to 'rage'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fury is violent anger, a synonym of rage.

clue.text: Having no money for bacon rasher or kedgeree either for starters

indicators.note: starters are the opening course, so the first letter of each of these words is taken

explanation.surface: Too poor for a breakfast of bacon or kedgeree, even as a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for starters' takes the first letters of 'bacon rasher or kedgeree either'. Kedgeree is a British breakfast dish of rice, fish and eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Being broke is slang for being penniless.

clue.text: Been less disturbed about the male groups

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go about, or around, the male letter
disturbed letters are jumbled out of order

explanation.surface: Bands that are less unsettled about the man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges BEEN LESS, and 'about' wraps that round M (male).
explanation.definitionFit: Ensembles are groups of musicians or performers working together.

clue.text: Lose one's rag and go mad with hostile feeling?

indicators.note: something mad is crazy, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Losing your temper and going berserk with animosity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' rearranges RAG and GO. 'Lose one's rag' (lose your temper) is surface dressing that only sets up 'rag'.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggro is British slang for aggressive hostility or trouble.

clue.text: Where people take steps to brush everything inside at first sight

indicators.note: the word for everything goes inside the brush

parts.note: a broom is a brush for sweeping
all means everything

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word sight is used

explanation.surface: Seeing a broom sweep up everything at a glance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take steps' suggests stairs or action; the definition plays on dance steps.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballrooms are halls for dancing, where couples perform dance steps.

clue.text: Colours with fury when I sent out the case

indicators.note: the rearranged letters form a case enclosing the word for fury
out signals the letters are put out of order

parts.note: anger means fury

explanation.surface: Turning colour with rage when I dispatch the suitcase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges I SENT into TINES, which as the 'case' holds ANGER.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangerine shades are orange hues, so these are colours.

clue.text: Origin of overturning man's address, for example

indicators.note: overturning turns the whole sequence upside down, which in a down-style reading means backwards

parts.note: MR is how a man is addressed

explanation.surface: The source of turning over a man's address, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturning' reverses MR + EG as a whole run.
explanation.definitionFit: A germ is the seed or origin from which something develops.

clue.text: Downgrading, say, during the narrative

indicators.note: during places one thing within another, so the example-word goes inside

parts.note: a relation is a telling, a narrative
EG, for example, is signalled by say

explanation.surface: Being demoted, for instance, partway through the story.
explanation.walkthrough: A relation in the old sense is an account or story told.
explanation.definitionFit: Relegation is demotion, especially to a lower sports division.

clue.text: See lots of changes that are lacking in digits

indicators.note: changes means the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Seeing lots of alterations in those who lack fingers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges SEE LOTS.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature without toes is toeless; toes are the digits of the foot.

clue.text: Name of religious leader with holy writings on a shrew

parts.note: a term is a word or name for something
an aga is a Muslim commander or leader
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A cleric's name with scriptures written about a nagging woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Name' looks like the abbreviation N; it gives TERM. 'with' and 'on a' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A termagant is a scolding, overbearing woman, as is a shrew.

clue.text: Always have ale to cook bird in

definitions.note: an adverb, defining an adjective meaning everlasting

indicators.note: the bird is placed in the cooked letters
to cook is to alter, so the letters of ale are mixed up

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: Constant advice: have beer to cook the bird in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cook' rearranges ALE into E..AL, with TERN put 'in'. 'Always' defines loosely, by an adjective in the sense 'for ever lasting'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something everlasting goes on for ever, without end.

clue.text: Bloomer upset cold hearted Russians

indicators.note: cold-hearted is read as having the cold letter at its heart
upset letters are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Russians, cold-hearted, are upset by a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a mistake, but it is a flower. 'hearted' puts C inside RUSSIANS and 'upset' rearranges all nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The narcissus is a spring flowering plant, so something that blooms.

clue.text: Gives fresh classification to holiday areas

explanation.surface: Reclassifying holiday destinations.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as re-sorts it means classifies again; as one word it means vacation towns.

clue.text: Graduates come up to university city on Sunday

indicators.note: in a down answer coming up means reading from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates
Bath is an English city with a university

explanation.surface: Graduates go up to a college town on Sunday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come up' reverses the graduates in this down light. BATH is a Somerset city with a university.
explanation.definitionFit: For many Christians the weekly day of rest and worship is Sunday.

clue.text: Arises unexpectedly around original rugged mountain ranges

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the first letter of rugged
unexpectedly suggests the letters arrive in an odd order
original means the first, so only the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: Craggy peaks rise up out of nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' rearranges ARISES, which goes 'around' R, the 'original' of 'rugged'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sierras are jagged chains of mountains, especially in Spanish-speaking lands.

clue.text: Spread out about a year, emerging in droplets

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about the year letter
out means the letters are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Spread out over a year, coming out as a fine mist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges SPREAD and 'about' wraps it round Y; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that has been sprayed is scattered as fine droplets.

clue.text: Yearn for good service around the hotel

indicators.note: the service word goes around the hotel letter

parts.note: an ace is an unreturnable serve in tennis
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Longing for excellent service at the hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: To ache for something is to long or yearn for it.

clue.text: Own name for sanctuary

parts.note: to own is to have

explanation.surface: A personal name for a place of refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: A haven is a place of safety or refuge.

clue.text: A bishop might sin, turning it on a deviation

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to err is to sin or go wrong

indicators.note: turning signals that the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bishop may go astray, flipping on a departure from the norm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' rearranges IT ON A into ATION; 'might' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An aberration is a departure from what is normal, a deviation.

clue.text: Marks on the staff

definitions.meaning: musical symbols placed on the five lines of a stave

explanation.definitionFit: Notes are jottings or marks, and also the musical symbols written on a staff of five lines.

clue.text: Able to hold correct amount of fish

indicators.note: to hold is to contain, so the right letter goes inside

parts.note: can means is able to
R stands for right, i.e. correct

explanation.surface: Able to hold the right quantity of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: A CRAN is a measure of fresh herrings, about 750 fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A cran is a traditional Scottish volume measure for landed herring.

clue.text: Notice unfinished poem has a series of lines on a rival

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter is taken off

parts.note: verse is poetry, a poem
RY abbreviates railway, a series of lines

explanation.surface: An advertisement for an incomplete poem lines up against a competitor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts the last letter of VERSE; 'has' and 'on' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: An adversary is an opponent or rival.

clue.text: Popular group have to make an input

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A popular band gets its say.
explanation.definitionFit: To inset is to insert something, putting it in.

clue.text: A number working on the joint

parts.note: ten is a number
on means functioning, working

explanation.surface: Some figure operating on the hinge.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenon is the projecting tongue of a mortise-and-tenon woodworking joint.

clue.text: Lotus eaters are dishonest twisters

indicators.note: twisters twist things, so the letters are wrung into a new order

explanation.surface: Pleasure-seekers are crooked cheats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisters' rearranges DISHONEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Lotus eaters, from the Odyssey, live in idle indulgence like pleasure-seekers.
